name: Nuts
description: Open source releases/downloads server with auto-updater

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Legacy access token; omit when using the GitHub App settings

GITHUB_APP_ID.description: Numeric GitHub App ID; all three App fields are required together

GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID.description: Numeric installation ID for the release-reader App

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Full RSA PEM private key with actual newlines; server-side secret
